correctness.rationale: Both five-row eight-bit codebooks reconstruct exactly from the published five-column vectors. For an output support Y, maximum likelihood over each code equals the likelihood of the least-weight word containing Y for all 0<p<1. A complete support-based partition yields the two exact polynomials and the identity difference p^2(1-p)^2(1+p)(2p^3+p-1). The strictly increasing cubic has exactly one positive root in (0,1), proving strict improvement for every p between that root and 1; at p=9/10, the exact positive average-success gap is 1044981/250000000. A separate exhaustive 256-output integer-polynomial verifier and independent rational-ML evaluation reproduce all stated values. No unsupported universal optimality is claimed.

originality.rationale: The closest primary sources (2011 workshop and 2013 full article) print the exact codebook and explicitly classify its five-message Z-channel optimality as conjectural. The explicit competing codebook and its exact open-noise interval strictly contradict that conjecture. Published optimality theorems for two through four messages do not apply to the five-message claim. Targeted searches across channel, parameter, and algebraic variants revealed no previously published identical counterexample; obscurity/nonindexing remains a genuine originality risk.
residual_risks: An obscure or unindexed earlier counterexample to the same five-message Z-channel conjecture may exist, despite checked primary sources and targeted query variants.
This result does not identify any globally optimal five-word length-eight codebook, or address larger lengths and other decoder/channel conventions.

value.rationale: The result directly refutes a specifically published all-noise five-message Z-channel code-design conjecture at the n=8 base of its even-length recursive family. The improvement exists throughout an exact nondegenerate open interval, not at an isolated floating-point setting, and arises inside the conjecture authors' own weak-flip column family. It isolates a concrete design flaw in column multiplicities and motivates re-examination of the recursion. Global-optimum identification is not needed for the value of a rigorous counterexample.
